nodes.text: Eleven days to first value today. This flow aims for three. The room's judgment on three open questions.
critique the flow, not the pixels
From signup to the first report a user opens. Most of it is spent connecting sources nobody asked for yet.
Six steps before any value. Users could not say what step three was for, and half of them stopped there.
Value on screen two. Every participant could say what the product does before setup began.
One source, one import, one report, one teammate. Everything else waits until the report exists.
twelve users, one script, two rounds
The user's path, screen by screen
One screen, one source. The other integrations wait until the first import has succeeded.
Progress with a real estimate. Large files stream; the user can leave and come back.
The first report drawn from their data, before any setup. This is the moment we are designing for.
One teammate, one click, and a link that opens on the preview, not on a blank workspace.
one chip per screen: what it commits to
the prototype walks this exact order
The three choices that shaped it
The report comes first; configuration comes after the user has seen the value. Rejected: a setup wizard.
Connecting five sources on day one is where users quit. Rejected: the integrations grid.
The invite link lands on the report. Rejected: an invite step in the wizard.
each of these cost us a feature request
Users could not tell what step three was for
Every participant understood what the product does
same tasks, same users, six weeks apart
Decided on three things, open on three. The flow does not go to build until the room has answered these.
the part we cannot decide alone
each one has a default; argue with it
Where we want the room's judgment
The preview needs data. Do we show a sample report, or hold the user on the import screen with help?
Streaming imports can take an hour. Do we let the user leave, and what brings them back?
Some teams want to invite first. Do we allow it, and does it dilute the preview moment?
tell us which, and why we are wrong
see you at the next round
Decisions from this room by Friday; the flow goes to build on Monday. Prototype and research notes are in the design folder.
silence by Friday ships the default
